# Generated background prompt set

Soft painterly schoolgirl anime package. One original adult female character across four launcher pages, blue-forward weather (rain, sun, vast sky). Not cyberpunk.

## Character

Age 19 original schoolgirl. Honey-blonde hair with sky-blue/cyan tips, large cyan-blue eyes, soft blush, white blouse, cyan-blue striped ribbon bow, navy pleated skirt, tiny cyan dragon hair clip. Face and rendering match the user's schoolgirl reference stills.

## Intro

Rainy blue sea and sky, transparent umbrella, character on the right, empty center/left for the VN logo overlay.

## Updater

Sunny school rooftop under a vast azure sky. Character on the right, left reserved for the updater card.

## Authentication

Rainy blue-hour seaside promenade with transparent umbrella. Character looking left toward the login card.

## Launcher

Close cinematic medium shot on a sunny school rooftop. Same girl looking back over her shoulder, wind in hair, generous azure sky on the left for the tool panel.
